components.css: .ds-btn { background: #9B5568; color: #fff; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 600 16px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #7F4256; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7F4256; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Price Card
components.description: Name, price and availability for one cake, clipped to the glass.
components.html:
Strawberry Chiffon Dream

From ₱1,250

Here today
components.css: .ds-price { position: relative; background: #FFFDF8; border: 1px solid #E6DFD0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 14px 14px; width: 220px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #231A1D; box-shadow: 0 10px 18px -12px rgba(35,26,29,0.6); } .ds-clip { position: absolute; top: -7px; left: 50%; width: 32px; height: 13px; margin-left: -16px; border-radius: 3px; background: #B9C1C5; border: 1px solid #98A2A7; } .ds-price p { margin: 4px 0 8px; color: #66595D; } .ds-price strong { font: 600 32px Caveat, cursive; color: #231A1D; } .ds-tape { background: #CFE6C8; color: #1D4519; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A neighborhood panaderya's glass case, online. Cakes on shelves, each with a clipped price card that says what it costs, whether it is there today, and how many days ahead to order. Rose is committed at page scale; the room is glass-white.
keyCharacteristics: Scalloped rose awning under the header
Rose case back wall with steel shelves
Card-stock price cards with a steel clip
Tape-style availability with the words on it

rules.name: Handwriting is for prices
rules.body: Caveat is used for prices and step numerals only.

dos: Do write lead times in words on the tape
Do label illustrations until real photos exist
donts: Don't introduce a second corner radius
